title: Dataset fetch manifest
description: File: data/datasets/<id>.yaml. One external dataset: where to fetch it, its expected hashes and its licence. Raw data is never committed; the fetch job (A10) downloads, hash-checks and caches it. See README.md 'Dataset manifests' and BUILD_SPEC.md section 10.

maintainer.description: Who publishes and maintains the data upstream (lab, institute, repository).

access.description: public = anyone can download; registration = free account needed; request = application or agreement needed; unknown = no confirmed public route (warned by the build).

files.description: Files the fetch job downloads. May be empty when access is request or unknown, or when files need a login the job doesn't have.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 (lowercase hex). null until the first 'pin' run; never guessed.

size_bytes.description: Size announced upstream (HTTP Content-Length or repository API) when read; null if unknown.

format.description: File format, e.g. xlsx, csv, tar, h5ad, dat, zip.

spdx_or_name.description: SPDX id (CC-BY-4.0, MIT…) or the name of the terms.

url.description: Page where the terms were read.

redistribution_of_derived.description: May Astra commit and publish small tables derived from this data? no/unclear = fetch manifest only, nothing derived committed until Verification decides.

licence_status.description: Set by Verification (A50) only. The fetch job fetches approved manifests only.

approved_by.description: Verification agent id, or president for a president ruling.

approval_ref.description: Row id in verification/approvals/licences.md that records the verdict, or PRn = president ruling in docs/decisions/president-rulings.md.

min_interval_seconds.description: Minimum wait between two requests to this host.

fetch.description: Hints for the fetch job, taken from the provider's terms.

access_blocked.description: Ref of the route-out tracking a source that blocks automated fetch (e.g. O9). The fetch job skips the dataset and lists it with this ref instead of failing. Absent = not blocked.

checked_at.description: Date the URLs and licence terms were last read on the official pages.

source_publications.description: DOIs of the papers that describe the data (ideally also cards in data/sources/).

used_by.description: Charter missions or obstacles that use the data, e.g. R-Metric, L1, O16.

fetched_at.description: Date of the pin run that recorded the hashes; null before.
